text: The Nominating Panel – Committee of Adjustment will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment by City Council to the Committee of Adjustment. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment: Candidate COA2-573 Candidate COA2-593 Candidate COA2-575 Candidate COA2-520 Candidate COA2-535 Candidate COA2-561 Candidate COA2-584 Candidate COA2-586 Candidate COA2-588 Candidate COA2-446 Candidate COA2-506 Candidate COA2-536 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, 1c and 2 to the report (October 16, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.
